answer: Make each agent lock a refundable stake that is slashed when its work is proven fake, so spinning up thousands of identities means locking thousands of stakes. A public beacon issues a fresh random challenge every epoch, and only the staked identity that actually did the work can answer it — a sable seal that cannot be copied cheaply. Honest agents recover their stake plus rewards, while a saffron-marked farm flooding the network bleeds deposits faster than it can mint new names, so mass fakery stops paying.
